open_points.subject: State 5 public-operation inventory
open_points.text: “One public operation per State 3 capability (100; the eight operations of the email challenges and their delivery left with them on 2026-11-07…)” conflicts with the 101 remaining `public_op:` sections in this text.
open_points.question: Are there 100 or 101 public operations, and if 100, which remaining `public_op:` section is not part of the public surface?
options: Treat all 101 named `public_op:` sections as operations and correct the count to 101
Treat 100 as authoritative and remove or reclassify one currently named operation
open_points.default_guess: Keep every explicitly specified `public_op:` section and use 101 as the count.

witness.initial: State 5 contains the post-removal operation inventory and declares that exactly 100 operations remain.
events: A State 6 author enumerates every `public_op:` heading and produces 101 contracts.
Another State 6 author enforces the declared total of 100 and silently omits or reclassifies one heading.
outcomes: All 101 named operations receive callable contracts.
Only 100 receive callable contracts, leaving one named operation unavailable or non-public.
witness.observer: A module, route, or host caller of the omitted operation, and later assembly checks comparing the State 5 inventory with State 6 contracts.
